name: Critical - Urgent Priority
description: For system outages, security incidents, and data loss scenarios affecting multiple users.

name: High Priority
description: For major functionality broken, significant performance degradation, or blocking issues for key workflows.

name: Standard - Medium Priority
description: For general issues, questions, and non-critical bugs that have workarounds.

name: Low Priority
description: For feature requests, cosmetic issues, and general inquiries that are not time-sensitive.

name: Enterprise Premium (Deprecated)
description: Legacy SLA for enterprise customers. Replaced by the new tiered SLA structure.
